name: GDCode
description: Write levels as code: a small level-scripting language compiled into real, editable Geometry Dash levels.

after-generate.name: After generating a level
after-generate.description: What to do once a level has been generated. <cy>editor</c>: open it in the level editor right away. <cy>level-page</c>: open its level page (Edit / Play buttons). <cy>stay</c>: stay in the GDCode window.

confirm-overwrite.name: Confirm before regenerating
confirm-overwrite.description: Ask before an existing generated level is replaced by a new generation of the same project.

max-objects.name: Object limit
max-objects.description: Safety cap on the number of objects one script may generate.
